title: chat-client *_query cannot send compound or metadata-02 filters
description: Found during JMAP-1j9k.2. Every extension client /query and /queryChanges now takes Option<&jmap_types::query::Filter<C>> (C: Serialize), and the chat *_query_changes methods do too. The chat *_query methods (chat_query, message_query, space_query, chat_contact_query, custom_emoji_query, plus Batch::chat_query_get / message_query_get) still build the filter by hand from *QueryInput fields (filter_kind, filter_muted, chat_id, ...), so callers cannot send RFC 8620 §5.5 AND/OR/NOT or draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-02 §3.5 conditions, and /query cannot be sent the same filter that /queryChanges accepts (RFC 8620 §5.6). Fixing it changes the *QueryInput layout or moves chat to the positional shape, which is the open question in JMAP-ops7.20. Once ops7.20 is decided: give chat *_query a filter: Option<&Filter<C>> (positional, or a field on the input struct) and add wire tests for a NOT operator and a WithMetadata leaf.
notes: DECIDED by Mark 2026-10-20: Unblocked by ops7.20 decision (positional). Part of the 0.4 freeze.
